    cuboids = []
    
    for _ in range(n):
        x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2 = map(int, input().split())
        cuboids.append((x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2))
    
    def overlap_positive(a1, a2, b1, b2):
        # Check if intervals [a1,a2] and [b1,b2] overlap with positive length
        return max(0, min(a2, b2) - max(a1, b1)) > 0
    
    def share_face(i, j):
        x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2 = cuboids[i]
        x1j, y1j, z1j, x2j, y2j, z2j = cuboids[j]
        
        # Check if they share a face (positive area)
        
        # Case 1: overlap in x,y with boundary contact in z
        if (overlap_positive(x1, x2, x1j, x2j) and 
            overlap_positive(y1, y2, y1j, y2j) and
            (z1 == z2j or z2 == z1j)):
            return True
            
        # Case 2: overlap in x,z with boundary contact in y
        if (overlap_positive(x1, x2, x1j, x2j) and 
            overlap_positive(z1, z2, z1j, z2j) and
            (y1 == y2j or y2 == y1j)):

        if (overlap_positive(y1, y2, y1j, y2j) and 
            overlap_positive(z1, z2, z1j, z2j) and
            (x1 == x2j or x2 == x1j)):
            return True
            
        return False
    
    results = []
    for i in range(n):
        count = 0
        for j in range(n):
            if i != j and share_face(i, j):
                count += 1
